messages:
sam: Quick sync 9: prepping Satellite QBR (renewal ~6 weeks). Need a tight deck: health, adoption, risks, and 3 exec asks. Who can own which slide?
priya: I'll take onboarding & adoption. Current onboarding completion: 78% (stalled at SAML + analytics SDK). Will attach cohort export.
marta: Ill draft the renewal/financial slide and the summary for the account exec. Need MAU and ARR by segment to show motion.
diego: Technical slide owner here. I'll include perf numbers pre/post-KV cache, and note the recent canary rollback + mitigation. Short bullet, not a deep postmortem.
eleanor: I'll craft the "ask" slide with 3 lines max. Propose: 1) SAML escalation to remove blocker, 2) 2-weekDedicated burst for perf validation, 3) approval to present a targeted price uplift for premium prompts. Keep wording decision-oriented.
priya: Pasting the looker snippet we use for adoption (for context):```sql
-- rolling MAU by week
SELECT week_start, count(distinct user_id) as MAU, sum(prompts) as total_prompts
FROM events
WHERE org = 'satellite'
AND week_start >= dateadd(week, -12, current_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```
sam: Can we get: weekly MAU for last 12 weeks + 30/60/90 conversion cohorts by EOD? Marta needs numbers to calculate renewal risk banding.
priya: On it  will drop a CSV and quick blurb: "Adoption trending up, but activation step X stalls at 22% due to SAML delays."
marta: Also need support load: tickets/week and time-to-resolve trend. Execs like to see impact on CS bandwidth.
priya: Support: avg 12/week last month, but TTR increased 30% during KV rollout. Adding to notes.
diego: Short technical risk note: KV cache canary had a 12% spike in error rate during high-concurrency tests; we rolled back within 2 hours. Mitigation: patch in staging + canary threshold lowered. I'll add a 1-line remediation timeline.
eleanor: For the asks, let's also add expected outcome and who will own the action if approved (1 line each). Example: "SAML escalation -> removes onboarding blocker; owner: eng-saml; ETA 10d."
sam: Action list: sam -> run dry-run + share final slides; diego -> update tech slide + risk remediation ETA; priya -> cohort CSV + adoption blurb; marta -> financial slide + ARR by segment; eleanor -> finalize asks phrasing. Dry-run Thurs 11am PT (25m).
ops-bot: Calendar created "Satellite QBR dry-run" Thu 11:00 PT (25m). Attendees: sam, priya, diego, eleanor, marta.
diego: Slide guidance: 6 slides max for execs: 1) TLDR health, 2) adoption, 3) tech risks, 4) renewal/risk, 5) asks, 6) next steps.
priya: CSV uploaded: https://files.example.com/satellite_adoption_12wk.csv. Dropping top usage customers below.
marta: Drafting slides now. Will share link in thread when ready.
eleanor: I'll prepare a 20s script for the exec readout to keep the meeting on time.
sam: Thanks team  aim to have final deck in the shared drive by tomorrow noon. Ping if you need clarifications. :raised_hands:
